Deepens distribution via a major HCM platform, boosting data supply and potential verification volumes.
Scale can drive higher hit rates and revenue from instant verifications.
Near-term timing gives a catalyst window for adoption tracking.
Efficiency gains can increase employer participation and recurring usage.

This extends Experian’s ongoing push to scale its verification network via payroll and employer-direct integrations. A larger catalyst would require disclosed adoption metrics, revenue impact, or monetization terms from Workday-linked volumes.
